tools.name: get_company_info
tools.title: Get company info
tools.description: Get OrthoAutomate's public company facts: what it does, who it serves, founder, service and page map, and how to book a call. Good starting point for any question about the business.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List every OrthoAutomate service (AI receptionist, instant lead response, treatment-plan follow-up) with slug, tagline, summary and page URL.

tools.name: get_service
tools.title: Get service details
tools.description: Get the full public detail of one OrthoAutomate service: intro, outcomes, how it works, features, who it is best for, and its FAQs. Use list_services first to find the slug.

slug.description: Service slug, e.g. ai-receptionist, lead-response, treatment-followup.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.title: List PMS integrations
tools.description: List the dental practice-management systems OrthoAutomate integrates with (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, Curve Dental), including supported capabilities and setup timeline.

tools.name: search_faqs
tools.title: Search FAQs
tools.description: Search OrthoAutomate's published FAQ answers about pricing, setup time, integrations, HIPAA/compliance, AI call handling and results. Omit the query to get every FAQ.

query.description: Keywords to match against questions and answers. Use an empty string for all FAQs.

limit.description: Maximum number of FAQs to return.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.title: List case studies
tools.description: List OrthoAutomate's published client case studies with clinic, location, service used, headline metrics, challenge, solution and result.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.title: List blog articles
tools.description: List OrthoAutomate blog articles with slug, title, one-sentence summary, author, publish/update dates and tags. Use get_article to read the full text.

tools.name: get_article
tools.title: Get blog article
tools.description: Read the full text of one OrthoAutomate blog article as markdown, including all sections and subsections. Use list_articles to find the slug.
